authority_constraints: UnifiedDB remains canonical durable Frankenstein state authority.
A derived graph/index is rebuildable projection only and cannot become a second truth store.
External-tool output is candidate/derived evidence, not effect or completion authority.
Architecture promotion requires later E3/E4 evidence and Trigger-4 integration measurement.

source_observations.claim: EntityEdge explicitly carries episode references plus expired_at, valid_at, invalid_at and reference_time, while retaining a fact string and optional fact embedding.
EpisodicNode retains source type, source_description, raw episode content, original-document valid_at, referenced entity-edge IDs and optional episode metadata.

The full package has a substantial dependency surface: Neo4j and OpenAI are hard dependencies in pyproject, with PostHog also hard-required; FalkorDB, Neptune, sentence-transformers and alternative LLM providers are optional extras.

The README describes continuous temporal graph updates, episode provenance and hybrid semantic/keyword/graph retrieval. These claims are useful hypotheses but receive no F2 performance or quality credit in this E2 result.

A recent upstream fix at 993e081a6d7948a0d8851c12a5fbdbeb49fed862 corrected prior node attributes being cleared on a no-applicable-entity-type path and noted that a backend-dependent test could be skipped in the default unit-test job. This is a concrete warning that mutation/driver/test-matrix semantics need independent F2 validation.

useful_mechanisms: episode/source lineage from derived facts back to raw admitted evidence
explicit fact validity windows instead of destructive overwrite
separate observation/reference time from fact-validity time
partition/group identity for bounded graph views
f2_mapping: Map Graphiti-style episode identity to canonical F2 event/admission/source identities; never invent a second canonical episode truth stream.
Map valid_at/invalid_at/expired_at/reference_time into typed derived temporal fields whose source rows remain in UnifiedDB.
Rebuild projection rows from canonical evidence and retain source digests/IDs so projection deletion/reconstruction never destroys truth.
Keep embeddings, graph traversal and retrieval scores explicitly derived and non-authoritative.
Do not let an LLM-extracted relationship automatically become a canonical fact; require F2 epistemic typing and provenance/evidence gates.
explicit_non_adoptions: Neo4j/FalkorDB/Neptune as a second canonical state database
Graphiti LLM extraction as factual authority
OpenAI/provider dependency as a required runtime path
Graphiti retrieval ranking as completion/effect authority
full package import before a thinner native projection is falsified

hypothesis: Graphiti's strongest transferable value for Frankenstein 2.0 is not the full graph stack but the typed temporal/provenance shape: raw episodes remain lineage anchors while derived facts carry validity and reference-time windows. Distilling that shape into a rebuildable UnifiedDB projection may improve temporal retrieval and contradiction handling without creating a second truth store.

counterhypotheses.claim: Existing UnifiedDB causal/time/provenance fields can already express the required semantics, so a Graphiti-derived projection adds complexity without measurable retrieval or reasoning benefit.
LLM-mediated entity/relation extraction introduces factual drift and schema instability that dominate the benefit of temporal edges.

A third-party graph database plus OpenAI/provider and telemetry dependencies are operationally heavier than a native SQLite-derived projection and conflict with the desired local/fail-closed envelope.
Temporal invalidation can accidentally hide conflicting evidence if implemented as truth replacement rather than query-time projection over immutable evidence.

design: Create immutable synthetic F2 evidence episodes with known observed/reference times and deliberate supersession/contradiction cases.
Materialize a minimal Graphiti-inspired temporal projection from those canonical rows without LLM extraction or external graph DB dependence.
Verify exact lineage round-trip, current-time and historical-time query correctness, preservation of contradictory evidence, deterministic replay and full rebuild equivalence.
Compare against direct UnifiedDB retrieval for query accuracy, latency, storage overhead and implementation complexity.
Fail if projection state can outlive or override its canonical source identity.
next_discriminator.promotion_condition: Only if the deterministic temporal projection produces reproducible information/retrieval benefit without truth-authority drift should Trigger 6 proceed toward an E4 F2 ablation or a build-candidate design.
